-- Rollback lesson compose_config refactor
BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE lesson ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS compose_config jsonb NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'lesson' AND column_name = 'compose_config_id'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            UPDATE lesson l
            SET compose_config = cc.config
            FROM compose_config cc
            WHERE l.compose_config_id = cc.id
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE lesson DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_lesson_compose_config;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_lesson_compose_config_id;
ALTER TABLE lesson DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS compose_config_id;

COMMIT;
